title: Account stakeholder map
description: Evidence-linked people with caller-supplied role/persona hypotheses. Cited text overlap does not verify a person-role relationship or authority.

role_evidence.description: Caller-selected text that overlaps a cited source excerpt; it is not proof of the mapped role.

role_mapping_status.description: The mapping has not been verified as a factual person-role relationship.

claim_ids.description: Normalized claim IDs used to identify the stakeholder role; each must occur in the brief claims.

evidence_ids.description: Normalized evidence IDs; the current evidence contract uses claim_id for this ID, so this set must equal claim_ids.
